title.name: Title Tag
title.desc: Crucial for search engines and social cards.
title.missing: Add a <title> tag to your HTML header.
title.tooShort: Title is shorter than 25 characters. Expand it to be more descriptive.
title.tooLong: Title exceeds 65 characters and may be truncated.
title.optimal: Optimal title length for search engines and social platforms.

desc.name: Meta Description
desc.desc: Summary snippet shown in search results and social previews.
desc.tooShort: Description is under 50 characters. Consider adding more context.
desc.tooLong: Description exceeds 165 characters and will be truncated.

canonical.name: Canonical URL
canonical.desc: Tells search engines the preferred URL to prevent duplicate content.

favicon.name: Favicon / Icon
favicon.desc: Appears in browser tabs and modern Google search results.

ogTitle.name: og:title Tag
ogTitle.desc: The headline shown when shared on social networks.

ogDesc.name: og:description Tag
ogDesc.desc: The description snippet on social networks.

ogImage.name: og:image Tag
ogImage.desc: The main preview thumbnail for social shares.
ogImage.missing: Add <meta property="og:image" content="..."> with a high quality image.
ogImage.httpWarning: Image uses HTTP instead of HTTPS. Some networks may refuse to load it.

ogUrl.name: og:url Tag
ogUrl.desc: Canonical share URL used by social platforms.

twitterCard.name: twitter:card Type
twitterCard.desc: Specifies summary or summary_large_image card display.

twitterTitle.name: twitter:title Tag
twitterTitle.desc: Title for Twitter/X cards (falls back to og:title).

themeColor.name: theme-color Tag
themeColor.desc: Used by Discord embeds and mobile browser tabs.

imageRatio.name: Image Resolution & Ratio
imageRatio.desc: Ideal 1.91:1 ratio (1200×630px) ensures crisp previews without cropping.
imageRatio.unknown: Image is present; verify dimensions are 1200×630px.
imageRatio.optimal: Perfect 1.91:1 ratio and high resolution (1200×630px or higher).
imageRatio.goodRatioLowRes: Good aspect ratio, but resolution is below recommended 1200×630px.
imageRatio.suboptimalRatio: Aspect ratio differs from 1.91:1 and may be cropped on some platforms.

exportModal.title: Generated HTML Meta Tags
exportModal.desc: Copy and paste these tags into your HTML <head> to enable rich social sharing.
